{{Quote|Come on, Latara, you know it hardly rains up there. And without the jinjang berries, the baby gubas might starve.|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka|<ref name="BftS" />}}
'''Jinjang berries''', also known as '''Gin-jang berries''', grew on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] ate some of the [[Berry/Legends|berries]] for dinner, and he later helped the Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] bring jinjang berries to a [[guba bird]] nest.

==Description==
Jinjang berries,<ref name="CSWE" /> or Gin-jang berries,<ref name="SWG:Gjb" /> grew from the [[jinjang]] [[Bush/Legends|shrub]], which was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="CSWE" /> They were [[Color/Legends|blue]] in color<ref name="BftS" /> and could be [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]],<ref name="HiWtSA" /> [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]s.<ref name="SWG:C9" /> The berries were typically used in [[Foodstuff/Legends|desserts]] to enhance flavors.<ref name="SWG:Gjb">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Gin-jang berries}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|What about dinner? You were supposed to get something to eat.''"<br />"''I did. The Kagles just made me tobo leaves, jing-jang berries, ''[sic]'' fried mahuga.|Wicket Warrick and Teebo|<ref name="HiWtSA" />}}
Sometime between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG date">The events of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' take place between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:SWG timeline|here]].</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] explored the Forest Moon of Endor and foraged the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] to find jinjang berries. The individual later used the [[Berry/Legends|berries]] to cook [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]] in a [[Corellian Fried Ice Cream Fryer]].<ref name="SWG:C9" />

[[File:MoreJinjangs-BFTS.png|thumb|left|280px|The Ewoks carrying the berries up the mountain]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{EwoksDate|the mention and appearance of [[jinjang]] [[Berry/Legends|berries]]|[[Home Is Where the Shrieks Are]]" and "[[Battle for the Sunstar]]}}</ref> a trio of the brown-[[Hair/Legends|furred]] individuals known as the [[Kagles]] served the [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]], along with [[fried mahuga]] and [[Tobo leaf|tobo leaves]], to the Ewok [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] while on Endor. Teebo later recounted the dinner's dishes to his friend, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]].<ref name="HiWtSA" />

Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> a group of [[Wokling/Legends|young Ewoks]]&mdash;Warrick, [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], Teebo, and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]]&mdash;carried a bagful of the berries each up a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] to a [[guba bird]] nest. Kintaka, whose idea it had been, expressed concern for the baby [[Bird/Legends|birds]], who would be in danger of starving due to the lack of [[Water/Legends|rain]]. She reached the top first, offering the jinjang berries to the gubas, but they instead plucked her from the nest, rose in the air, and dropped her; her weight caused the nest to sag down and then spring up, launching the Ewoks to the bottom of the mountain.<ref name="BftS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jinjang berries were first mentioned in "[[Home Is Where the Shrieks Are]],"<ref name="HiWtSA" /> the third episode in the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']], which premiered on [[September 20]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> They later appeared in "[[Battle for the Sunstar]]," the twentieth episode of the season,<ref name="BftS" /> which first aired on [[December 6]] that same year.<ref name="Insider 27" />

The [[Disney+]] subtitles for "Home Is Where the Shrieks Are,"<ref name="HiWtSA" /> added on [[April 2]], [[2021]],<ref name="Vintage">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-vintage-collection-disney-plus|text=The ''Star Wars'' Vintage Collection Has Arrived on Disney+!}}</ref> spell the berries' name as "jing-jang berries,"<ref name="HiWtSA" /> while the subtitles for "Battle for the Sunstar" use "jinjang."<ref name="BftS" /> Jinjang berries, spelled "Gin-jang," also appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Gjb" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Meanwhile, [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' included an entry for the berries' bush, spelled "jinjang."<ref name="CSWE" /> Among the two subtitled spellings, "jinjang" is the lone version that is also reflected in other source material&mdash;''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia''&mdash;so this article uses this as the primary spelling, notes ''Galaxies''{{'}} spelling as valid, and treats the second Disney+ spelling as an error.

Jinjang berries were added to ''Galaxies'' as a [[W:c:swg:Foraged Rare Component|rare foraged food component]] for the [[W:c:swg:Corellian Fried Ice Cream Fryer (Schematic)|portable deep fryer]], introduced with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|Chapter 9]],"<ref name="SWG:C9" /><ref>{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67692&month=042008|text=Weekly Picks – 4/3/08 - 04/03/2008}}</ref> published on [[April 3]], 2008.<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
